Package io.github.jspinak.brobot.tools.history.draw

Class MatchHighlighter

java.lang.Object
io.github.jspinak.brobot.tools.history.draw.MatchHighlighter
@Component public class MatchHighlighter extends Object
Provides visual highlighting functionality for matches on screen with mock support.

This V2 wrapper class works with ActionConfig instead of ActionConfig. It abstracts Sikuli's highlighting operations to visually indicate matched regions on the screen. It supports both persistent highlights (turnOn/turnOff) and timed highlights. The class handles a Sikuli limitation where Match objects don't highlight properly by converting them to Region objects.

In mock mode with no screenshots, highlighting operations are logged instead of displayed. When screenshots are available in mock mode, actual highlighting is performed on the screenshots for visual verification.

The class ensures minimum visibility by setting a default size of 10x10 pixels for zero-dimension matches to make them visible when highlighted.

  • Method Details

    • turnOn

      public void turnOn(Match match, StateObjectMetadata stateObject, ActionConfig config)
      Activates a persistent highlight on the specified match.

      The highlight remains visible until explicitly turned off with turnOff(io.github.jspinak.brobot.model.match.Match). In mock mode without screenshots, the operation is logged instead of displayed. The highlight color is determined by the action configuration.

      Parameters:
      match - The match to highlight. Must not be null.
      stateObject - Additional state information for logging purposes in mock mode.
      config - Configuration containing the highlight color to use.

    • turnOff

      public void turnOff(Match match)
      Deactivates a persistent highlight on the specified match.

      This method removes highlights previously activated with turnOn(io.github.jspinak.brobot.model.match.Match, io.github.jspinak.brobot.model.state.StateObjectMetadata, io.github.jspinak.brobot.action.ActionConfig). In mock mode without screenshots, no action is taken as there's no actual highlight to remove.

      Parameters:
      match - The match to stop highlighting. Must not be null.

    • highlight

      public boolean highlight(Match match, StateObjectMetadata stateObject, ActionConfig config)
      Displays a timed highlight on the specified match for a configured duration.

      This method works around a Sikuli limitation where Match objects don't highlight properly by converting the match to a Region. For zero-dimension matches (e.g., point clicks), it ensures visibility by setting a minimum size of 10x10 pixels.

      The method performs a brief 1-second highlight on the match itself before highlighting the region, which helps with visual debugging.

      Parameters:
      match - The match to highlight. Zero-dimension matches are expanded to 10x10 pixels for visibility.
      stateObject - Additional state information for logging in mock mode.
      config - Configuration containing highlight duration (seconds) and color settings.
      Returns:
      true if the highlight was displayed (or logged in mock mode), always returns true in current implementation.
